scripts.build: bun run build:packages && bun run build:registries && bun run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: bun run --filter '@vibe3djs/schema' build && bun run --filter '@vibe3djs/registry-sdk' build && bun run --filter '@vibe3djs/registry' build && bun run --filter '@vibe3djs/conformance' build && bun run --filter '@vibe3djs/terrain' build && bun run --filter 'vibe3d' build && bun run --filter 'vibe-model' build && bun run --filter 'vibe-terrain' build
scripts.build:registries: bun run --filter '@scifi-kit/registry' build && bun run --filter '@f1-kit/registry' build
scripts.build:apps: bun run --filter '@vibe3djs/docs' build && bun run --filter '@vibe3djs/recorder' build
scripts.typecheck: bun run build:packages && bun run typecheck:legacy && bun run --workspaces typecheck
scripts.typecheck:legacy: bun run typecheck:browser && bun run typecheck:node
scripts.release:check: bun run build && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.release: bun run release:check && bunx --bun changeset publish
